say: Lewis Hall is off to Manchester United. So who replaces him at Newcastle?
cap: LEWIS HALL IS OFF TO MANCHESTER UNITED. SO WHO REPLACES HIM AT NEWCASTLE?

say: He's second of every Premier League full-back for dribbles, blocked shots and ball recoveries. But not many assists.
cap: HE'S SECOND OF EVERY PREMIER LEAGUE FULL-BACK FOR DRIBBLES, BLOCKED SHOTS AND BALL RECOVERIES. BUT NOT MANY ASSISTS.

say: So we compared him with all 140 left-backs in Europe's top five leagues. Every stat per ninety, two thousand tests.
cap: SO WE COMPARED HIM WITH ALL 140|140 LEFT-BACKS IN EUROPE'S TOP FIVE LEAGUES. EVERY STAT PER 90|ninety, 2,000|two-thousand TESTS.

say: The two closest: Javi Galán and Neco Williams.
cap: THE TWO CLOSEST: JAVI GALÁN AND NECO WILLIAMS.

say: But Galán is thirty-one. And Williams is twenty-five, worth forty-two million euros.
cap: BUT GALÁN IS 31|thirty-one. AND WILLIAMS IS 25|twenty-five, WORTH €42M|forty-two-million-euros.

say: Hall is only twenty-two. So: twenty-three and under only.
cap: HALL IS ONLY 22|twenty-two. SO: 23|twenty-three AND UNDER ONLY.

say: And number one is Kaiki, from Como.
cap: AND NUMBER ONE IS KAIKI, FROM COMO.

say: He's twenty-three, and worth fifteen million euros. A quarter of Hall's price.
cap: HE'S 23|twenty-three, AND WORTH €15M|fifteen-million-euros. A QUARTER OF HALL'S PRICE.

say: Hall against Kaiki, on what makes Hall special: dribbles, blocked shots, ball recoveries and passes.
cap: HALL AGAINST KAIKI, ON WHAT MAKES HALL SPECIAL: DRIBBLES, BLOCKED SHOTS, BALL RECOVERIES AND PASSES.

say: And Kaiki creates more chances, and dribbles even more. Early days though: only five games' worth this season.
cap: AND KAIKI CREATES MORE CHANCES, AND DRIBBLES EVEN MORE. EARLY DAYS THOUGH: ONLY FIVE GAMES' WORTH THIS SEASON.

say: So Newcastle's next Lewis Hall? Kaiki. Would you sign him? Follow for more.
cap: SO NEWCASTLE'S NEXT LEWIS HALL? KAIKI. WOULD YOU SIGN HIM? FOLLOW FOR MORE.
